title: I Want to Break Free! Persuasion and Anti-Social Behavior of LLMs in Multi-Agent Settings with Social Hierarchy
reasoning: The paper investigates the emergence of anti-social behaviors such as toxicity, harassment, and violence in hierarchical social settings inspired by the Stanford Prison Experiment. It explicitly evaluates the 'decency and morality' of AI-to-AI interactions and explores the manifestation of unethical conduct, which falls under the evaluation of morals and ethics.
